source.author: Wowhead Looter (multiple contributors, identities not exposed)

quote: This item has been disenchanted 1993 times.
notes: Primary rendered Wowhead Looter table independently opened 2026-11-19 by selecting Related > Disenchanting. Boulderfist Bracers (24989) is uncommon plate; separate TBC Classic item version is item-level 105, but cumulative events have NO reported era, patch, bonus ID, caster skill, profession specialization, or current Retail DE eligibility. Source reports 1477 Arcane Dust occurrences among 1993 aggregate disenchant operations, not total material units. Looter displays conditional stack range 2-7, not a 0-inclusive histogram. Listed material hits total 1947 across this item and leave 46 operations unaccounted for; missing events MUST NOT be treated as zero or exclusive-outcome evidence. No source-supplied event-level joint ledger, receipts/refunds, or gold values. Distinct gear-item cohort; do not combine with historical 24995 Looter snapshot as one input.
